title: No lemon or salt at home, but show outside
odia:
ଘରେ ନଥାଇ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଲୁଣ
ବାହାରେ ଦେଖ ଚାତର ପଣ।
literal_meaning: No lemon or salt at home—look at the show outside.
meaning_odia: ଘରେ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଲୁଣ ପରି ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଜିନିଷ ନାହିଁ, ଅଥଚ ବାହାରେ ବଡ଼ ଆଡ଼ମ୍ବର। ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଅନୁସାରେ କଥାଟି ବୃଥା ବାହ୍ୟ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନକୁ ଉପହାସ କରେ। ଘରର ବାସ୍ତବ ଅବସ୍ଥା ଓ ବାହାରେ ଦେଖାଯାଉଥିବା ଠାଣିର ଫରକ ଏହାର ମୂଳ କଥା।
explanation: The household lacks even the small provisions named in the first line, while its public face puts on a show. The inspected gloss identifies empty outward ostentation. The target is the mismatch between provision and display, rather than a person’s lack of resources.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A club spends its effort on a grand public display while leaving the basic supplies for its work unprovided. A member uses the saying to question those priorities.
cultural_context: ଘରେ and ବାହାରେ set private provision against public appearance. Lemon and salt supply a concrete, modest measure of what is missing; ଚାତର ପଣ names the display that makes the contrast conspicuous.

witnesses.locator: Page15 final line continued at page16 first line, beginning ଘରେ ନଥାଇ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଲୁଣ.
witnesses.note: Rendered pages inspected17November2026; wording and verse line break retained, including separate ଚାତର ପଣ.

Longer counterpart has ନାହିଁ, ଲେମ୍ୱୁଲୁଣ, ଦାଣ୍ଡରେ and joined ଚାତରପଣ, followed by an additional clause claiming three dishes. Explicit gloss identifies empty outward ostentation. Uploaded shorter text retained.

english_summary: Public show conceals the absence of basic provision at home.
